<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that breaks an aliphatic carboxylic acid and forms an amide (C–N bond formation, C–O bond cleavage) in the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
